text:
Priya: Quick RFC — propose we cut raw SIEM export retention for non-prod tenants from 90d -> 30d, keep scrubbed analytic streams at 365d. Reason: storage + attack surface, and we still provide forensics snapshots via timeboxed unwrapped exports. Thoughts?
Marco: 👍 what's the proposed process for unwrapping KMS keys for those snapshots?
Priya: plan is JIT unwrap handled by a short-lived CMK grant via the KMS-proxy. Analyst requests create a ticket, automation issues ephemeral unwrap token for 4h, audit log + approver pinned to ticket.
Alex: who can request unwraps? SOC only or SRE + incident responder too?
Priya: suggest: SOC analysts (view-only) can request; SRE & incident responders can request but require manager approval unless emergency flag.
Jordan: emergency flag sounds fine, but need a post-facto audit window and auto-revoke. Can we attach an automatic evidence-handoff checklist to the ticket?
Priya: yes — checklist includes: purpose, scope (start/end timestamps), scrub instructions, consumer list, retention TTL for snapshot, and evidence handback steps. Automation will attach the checklist to the unwrap token metadata.
Olivia: do we have a template for the ticket fields? can we reuse the existing forensic snapshot request form?
Priya: I'll attach a link to the new template later, but fields are minimal: dataset id, justification, TTL (max 72h), approver, requestor contact.
Marco: TTL 72h ok, but add a default 24h for low-severity cases. Also require token rotation of the CMK after any export used in an external handoff.
Alex: rotation every time? that could be disruptive. maybe require rotation only for exports delivered off-network or to external auditors.
Priya: agree — internal handoffs no CMK rotation, external deliveries require CMK rotation and recorded key-id in ticket.
Jordan: RBAC change needed: new role 'siem_unwrap_requester' and 'siem_unwrap_approver'. Requester can't see raw logs unless unwrap granted. Approver rotation and 2i rule for >24h TTL.
Olivia: can we enforce approver 2i via workflow? like require a second approver for TTL >24h?
Priya: yes automation enforces 2nd approver for >24h, and SecurityBot will post an immutable audit event in #security-audit.
SecurityBot: [automated] unwrap_request created: ticket #SF-1428, requester=Jordan, dataset=auth-logs-prod-snapshot, TTL=24h, approver=Priya. AuditID=ai_2026_8742
Marco: one more ask — retention policy text needs clarity for legal: keep raw snapshot metadata for 7 years, but actual unwrapped content removed per TTL.
Priya: noted. I'll update the RFC doc with metadata retention spec & the SLA for approves/denials (24h non-urgent).
Alex: ok, please add a short rollback plan if automation fails (e.g., fallback to masked exports).
Priya: adding rollback steps + runbook for failed KMS-proxy calls. I'll post the updated RFC and a short walkthrough next week. Thanks folks :rocket:
